crossRefs.note: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion.…

crossRefs.note: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.
translations.bsb: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
translations.kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
translations.asv: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
